I didn't record 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply because it doesn't match the contracts. I replied to Tobias in his #central-team thread to tell him.

- The Marrow Agrisupply affiliate amendment was signed 2025-10-02 and took effect 2025-10-15. It sets Agrisupply at 40 seats.
- The 2026 renewal order form, signed 2026-04-22, only changed Marrow Fieldworks, to 95 seats. It says it doesn't change Agrisupply's seat count.

So Agrisupply's count on file is still 40. I asked Tobias whether 382 was meant for another account, or whether there's a newer amendment or true-up I don't have. If he points me to signed paperwork, I'll update the record. Seat counts are operational facts the account team can see, so it was fine to discuss them in the channel. I left out pricing.
